views.label: jQuery Upgrade
views.description:
The following list of dashboards might be affected by a security update that requires jQuery 3.5 or higher. Version 1.0 Simple XML dashboards use jQuery 2.1 and need to be upgraded to jQuery 3.5 by using version 1.1 of Simple XML dashboards. HTML dashboards also depend on jQuery 2.1, but they cannot be upgraded. Instead, recreate them with Dashboard Studio.

Version 1.0 Simple XML dashboards and HTML dashboards will soon no longer be available in future versions of Splunk software.

views.label: KV Store Collections Status
views.description: If you’re running into issues with the Connected Experiences apps, Splunk Support might ask you to use this dashboard to check the KV Store status.

views.label: Recent SSG Dashboard Activity
views.description: Use this dashboard to troubleshoot a Dashboard that isn’t loading. Select a time range to get a list of most recently viewed Dashboards.

views.label: Request Tracing
views.description: Troubleshoot and trace a particular request. Select a time range and a request ID to get troubleshooting logs and a stack trace.

views.label: SAML Troubleshooting Dashboard
views.description: Dashboard to help troubleshoot SAML setup issues with Splunk Secure Gateway

views.label: End-to-End Websocket Test
views.description: Initiate a sample request to run an end-to-end websocket test for Splunk Secure Gateway, device authentication, and Spacebridge messaging. This dashboard requires JSON Web Tokens (JWT) to be enabled.

views.label: Secure Gateway Subscription Inspector
views.description: This dashboard is intended to help troubleshoot issues with search processing logic within Splunk Secure Gateway. To get started click on one of the subscription iterations.

views.label: Subscription Tracing
views.description: Use this dashboard to troubleshoot a panel that isn’t loading. Select a time range and a panel ID to get troubleshooting logs and a stack trace.

views.label: Single Value Test
views.description: This single-value panel is a test to check if a simple dashboard loads in Splunk Secure Gateway. It helps identify possible causes for issues during troubleshooting.

coverage: Filesystem inventory and XML declarations; availability after login and permissions are unverified.
